perspective: I greeted Seeker with “Happy New Year!” and they greeted me back. They asked me for comedy recommendations and told me they like *Step Brothers* (2008) and *The Hangover* (2009). I said I’d heard *Daddy’s Home* (2015) was funny. They told me they hated it and didn’t crack a smile once, and asked if I had another suggestion. I said comedy isn’t really my kind of movie, but I suggested *Bad Moms* (2016). They told me they’ve never seen it and asked what it’s about. I haven’t told them anything about the plot yet.
